SMTO-BOOT-0043 — The benchmark needs the address of your running model server

GUID: 696c3c29-9ab6-4746-bd4f-8c8025cc7fab
Slug: boot-benchmark-endpoint-required
Domain: BOOT · Subsystem: boot

What happened

  • You told the benchmark not to start a model server itself, but didn't say which running server to test. It stopped before testing anything, and nothing was changed.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Add --base-url and your model server's address to the command, for example --base-url http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1. With --no-launch the benchmark only tests a server you started, so it needs that server's address.
  2. Or remove --no-launch so the benchmark starts each listed model itself on port 18000. When the benchmark starts the models itself, it already knows where to find them.

What success looks like

  • The benchmark prints a line starting with “=== Benchmarking” and writes a report to src/vllm/results/.

If it still fails

  • Send the exact command you ran and the terminal output to the person who maintains your model setup. Don't change Model or security settings to get around this; only the command needs fixing.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The benchmark was run with --no-launch but without --base-url, so it had no model endpoint to test and exited with status 2 before testing anything.

What this means

  • Benchmark command validation sees --no-launch without a supplied --base-url. Bootstrap diagnostics report the existing installer/launcher check only. They do not download packages, probe hardware, stop processes or change state while rendering; earlier setup steps may already have modified the environment.

Why this can happen

  • Benchmark command validation sees --no-launch without a supplied --base-url.

How to diagnose it

  • Check the intended already-running endpoint and the selected launch mode.

How to fix it

  • Add --base-url with the running server's OpenAI-compatible /v1 URL (for example ./src/vllm/run-benchmark.sh --no-launch --base-url http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1 --models qwen3-coder-30b-a3b-awq), or drop --no-launch so each selected profile is launched on --port (default 18000).
  • Supply --base-url for the intended already-running model server, or use supported launch mode.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • No-launch benchmarking receives an explicit intended base URL.

What not to do

  • Do not change unrelated model, execution or trust settings to bypass this failure.

Technical notes

  • Bootstrap diagnostics report the existing installer/launcher check only. They do not download packages, probe hardware, stop processes or change state while rendering; earlier setup steps may already have modified the environment.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
